cases.title: Staff approval creates the kitchen; the applicant becomes a cook only after START_REVIEW and APPROVE with fresh MFA
prerequisites: FX-STAFF-OPS (PROVISION): operations staff with the grants of docs/quality/owner-acceptance/fixtures.json / deploy/web-preview/seed-owner-e2e.sql: cook.review, content.moderate, order.ops, order.exception_cancel, order.handover_override (no support.case). Verify only the grants the case needs: SELECT permission FROM user_grant g JOIN app_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE u.subject = '<subject>' AND g.revoked_at IS NULL includes them.

FX-COOK-PENDING (PROVISION): Keycloak user + app_user whose cook_application is in state SUBMITTED (current_revision 1, no decision yet), public_name 'مطبخ القبول', bio 'أكل بيتي تجريبي', contact_phone +201000000999, private_location 'عنوان تجريبي رقم 5', pickup_enabled true, zone_ids {00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000a001}, no documents. Staff high-risk actions need a Keycloak second factor. On origin/develop (0eaf755) the preview realm has no OTP flow (docs/operations/06-web-preview.md line 173: 'staff actions that need MFA are not available, because no OTP is configured in the preview realm'; matbakhy-realm.preview.json at that ref has no authenticationFlows, acr.loa.map or amr mapper), so this case cannot pass there. FX-STAFF-OPS has an authenticator app (TOTP) available for the Keycloak step-up (first step-up enrols it). The two accounts are different people (a reviewer can never decide their own application).

Use a separate browser profile (or private window) per actor: the API session cookie is shared across the ops and customer hosts, so signing in as a second actor in the same profile replaces the first session.
